sample: So you're the one who fixes things. Is it the taking apart, or getting it working again? Fair enough. Three that might be new to you: sound designer, assistive tech, fabrication.

configs.label: Neutral / steady
configs.note: The provider default. Clear, but flat for a one-to-one conversation.

configs.label: Warm / slightly slower
configs.note: More variation within a sentence and a little more thinking time. Closest to an older sibling.

configs.label: Brisk / more animated
configs.note: Faster and more pushed. Reads as a presenter or an advert, not a conversation.

reasoning: Warm/slightly slower keeps sentence-level variation without turning into a performance. A slower pace gives a 15 to 18 year old room to answer, and the scripted 30-word ceiling keeps turns short regardless. Teen naturalness ratings are a human test and are not claimed here.
unverified: Average naturalness rating from five teenage testers
